scope: Restricted top-level getter/setter annotations and metadata-only relinking on host ARM64

not_accepted: Full M1 language/runtime compatibility and the historical native suite were not rerun.

Package accessors, broader language-version combinations and accessor signature/layout changes need separate validation.
